description: Check the public DNS TXT record for a site registered to the signed-in account. Pass its registration UUID as id. A matching record marks the target verified. A missing or mismatched record clears any previous verification and returns pending. If pending, have the owner check the TXT record and retry the same id after DNS propagation. A temporary DNS error preserves the saved ownership status. The Watchtower overview lists verified sites without rechecking DNS. Verification costs no credits.

id.description: The target UUID returned at registration. Use the same ID when retrying.

name: vulkill_watchtower_verify_target
title: Check and update site ownership
